first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, a direct metric we can address. Memory_31 showed signup simplification lifted SMB activation durably; memory_86 confirmed shortened onboarding improved completion rates and time-to-value. Both are foundational to the current problem. Activation_messaging (memory_91) is also relevant context since activation is down 6% QoQ, but onboarding completion feeds activation—fixing the funnel entry point addresses root cause. Promotional_pricing would compete directly with the competitor but risks margin and doesn't solve the activation decline. Referral_incentives work for established customers, not acquisition. Enterprise_sales_assist addresses a different segment. A small guarded test on signup/onboarding simplification directly targets the measured decline, leverages validated learning, and preserves our ability to learn whether conditions have shifted since day 12 and day 52. This avoids wasteful rollout risk while protecting qualified revenue focus.
